theorem lg_target : (Finset.filter (fun n => n % 3 = 0) (Finset.range 30)).card = 10 := by
  let p := fun n => n % 3 = 0
  let n := 30
  rw [Nat.count_eq_card_filter_range p n]
  rw [Finset.card_range n]
  rw [Nat.div_eq_floor_div_right]
  exact_mod_cast (Nat.div_eq_floor_div_right 30 3)
